thread:
maya: Heads-up — need to land PR #20145 before the Monday blackout (02:00 UTC). Blocked on mac CI and one final approval. CI queue shows 6 pending mac runs. Can someone take a quick look or kick a rerun if green?
ryan: I can do a fast review. Noted mac flakiness lately — saw setup failures on mac-11. pinging @eng-ci for queue status.
eng-ci-bot: [ci-queue] mac-latest queue length: 6. Estimated drain ~18m. Backfill runners available in us-west-2.
sam: I can rerun the failing job, but PR needs a rebase onto main to pick up the flake fix. @maya can you rebase?
maya: Rebased just now before posting. Kicked a rerun for mac at 3945678908 (request id: run-98312).
ci-bot: run-98312 — mac-latest started on runner r-usw2-7.
tess: Quick approve from me on the non-migration changes; left a couple of tiny nits but not blocking. @jordan take the db migration piece please.
jordan: Looking at the migration diff now. If CI is green and I approve, can we do a canary first? Prefer 10% traffic for 30m.
ryan: SGTM. Canary with auto-rollback on error. Ops should be ready to rollback quickly if needed. @oncall-eng FYI.
ops-bot: Oncall eng pager duty: ryan (notified).
jordan: CI finished and green (mac + linux). Approved. Maya, please set rollout: canary 10% for 30m, fallback to previous on failures.
maya: Canary scheduled and merge gated on artifact verification. Will merge after final artifact checksum check (~2m).
ryan: :thumbsup: nice.
sam: I kicked a backfill which cleared a couple queued jobs — estimated drain down to ~3m.
maya: Merged at 3945679012. Thanks all for quick help.
ryan: Great coordination — saved the Monday blackout.
maya: Adding a short postmortem note in the PR about the mac flake and the rebase requirement to help next time.
